caption: AI hype vs usefulness is real. These prompts test practical value, not buzz. What will you test first? #AIforWork #PracticalAI #Productivity

slides.title: Is AI hype worth it
slides.body: A practical check to prove AI adds real value, not buzz. Try these 5 prompts.

slides.title: 1. Quick Task Audit
slides.body: Review my tasks: [role] list tasks AI can handle; output a table of AI fit and required human checks.

slides.title: 2. Idea Spark
slides.body: Generate [idea] options for a project using AI; return top 5 ranked by impact vs effort.

slides.title: 3. Draft Outline
slides.body: Create a draft outline for [task] with sections and milestones; output as a numbered checklist.

slides.title: 4. Decision Log
slides.body: Log decisions on [task] with criteria and notes; output a decision tree or bullet list.

slides.title: 5. ROI and Risks
slides.body: Estimate impact for [initiative], list top drivers, and compute rough ROI; output a short justification.

slides.title: Bottom Line
slides.body: Remember this: test AI in real tasks. Save this post and follow @naelbuildingbig.
